title: Microsoft completes construction on first datacenter facility in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin (Microsoft Source, 2026-06-23)
notes: Microsoft primary (2026-06-23). Fairwater first facility fully operational in Mount Pleasant, WI (Racine County); 'world's most powerful supercomputer' (Brad Smith); $4.7B local spend 2024-2028; second facility under construction (2028). The ~3.3 GW campus figure is an Epoch AI analyst projection, NOT Microsoft-disclosed.
